steps: A project without a script document type offers two known GDScript starters. Full source preview and selected fields persist in Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px with visible Return/Create/Cancel. Cancel changes no editor state or author files.

Create script opens the normal TXT source draft and focuses its editor without any file or registration write. Ordinary Save stores the reviewed GDScript bytes under the existing character type, adds only source plus registration, and immediately makes that source visible to first-behavior creation.

A saved Scene2D without any behavior opens first-behavior creation. Full source and all three relationships are reviewed, then Cancel writes nothing. Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px preserve fields and review, keep Return/Review/Save visible, and allow body scrolling without horizontal overflow.

One reviewed transaction creates exactly the manifest and its registration and appends the scene behavior relationship, retaining the scene metadata CRLF. Scene/script/asset source bytes are unchanged. The explicit Open button enters the real source editor and exposes the existing behavior editor.
The existing behavior editor adds text/number parameters and a signal alias. Apply only changes the draft; ordinary Save persists those exact reviewed bytes and changes no other author files.

The newly created and edited manifest drives real Godot plan → build → headless run: the selected instance emits script_authoring_checkpoint with script_authored_in_studio/65, bound to the newly created stable binding ID.
